$comment: Performance budgets in milliseconds. GALEO_PERF_ENFORCE=1 (the release check, on the owner's machine) holds the median to these; other runs fail only above 3x. Cold start: tightened on 2026-10-21 to the profiled build's medians + ~10 % (owner; 850 / 1300 ms since v0.1, PRD 2026-10-05); the PRD's 500 ms target stays the goal. warmSwitchMs is one frame at 60 Hz (the PRD's 'next frame'). splitTypingMs: last keystroke to the preview painted, in a 5,000-word article in split, the 150 ms typing pause included (owner, 2026-10-09, from a 260 ms median). jsonTreeOpenMs / csvTableOpenMs: launch to the first row painted, a 9 MB / 195k-node JSON and a 100 MB CSV, cold start included (csvTableOpenMs is ADR-020's target; jsonTreeOpenMs a starting value, both set from the first measurements). logScrollFrameMs / logFollowMs: a generated 100 MB log; the median frame while paging through its top, middle and end (one frame at 60 Hz), and an appended line painted while the log is followed. Set 2026-10-26 from the first measurements (16.7 ms; 1609 to 1762 ms, nearly all of it reading the whole file again); logFollowMs tightened to 500 ms on 2026-11-07 when re-reads started sending only what was added (ADR-033; median 260 ms, p95 300 ms). findAllMainDelayMs: the longest main stays busy at once during a find-all query over three never-shown 100 MB tabs (ASCII, multibyte UTF-8, Windows-1252), the median of 3 queries; set 2026-11-02 when decoding moved to the task worker (from ~540 ms to 12-22 ms). changeMarksMs: coming back to a 1 MB Markdown plan with 50 scattered changes, the time from its new text showing to all 50 change marks drawn (the diff and the marking, ADR-030), the median of 5; set 2026-11-04 from the first runs (about 14 ms on a loaded machine; showing the new text itself took 1.5-2.7 s there).
